title: Error after width truncation
statement: Let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\varepsilon>0$, and let $\psi$ be a CNF formula on the Boolean cube $\{-1,1\}^n$ with at most $s$ clauses. Retain only clauses of width at most $\left\lceil\log_2(s/\varepsilon)\right\rceil$ to form a truncated formula. The fraction of inputs on which the original and truncated formulas differ is at most $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: ψ has at most s clauses
